scope: Generic n-point quotients of XY=1,P(X)*Z=Q(X), coprime Q/P of degree Q<=degree P with P(0) nonzero, in every characteristic. A uniform O(n^2*log(n+1)) bound closes the whole generic family. Numerical special samples are not assumed generic. Laurent identities, generic evaluation, monotone support slopes and Euclidean floor sums are classical inputs.

special_sample_counterexamples.scope: Explicit reduced special samples refute extending generic stabilization to every f.

general_denominator_controls.scope: Monic degree-k integer denominators with constant one, sparse and geometric-sum cases, and coprime nonconstant monomial numerators of degree one or k, in several characteristics. The uniform proof covers all coprime Q/P regular at zero and infinity.
